user.description: Enter your NiceHash API credentials. Create them at NiceHash → Settings → API Keys (permissions needed: view accounts, view mining).

error.invalid_auth: Invalid credentials or insufficient API permissions. Verify the API key, secret, and organization ID, and that the key has 'view' permissions enabled.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to NiceHash. Check your internet connection and try again.

abort.already_configured: This NiceHash organization is already configured.
